question: Dhruvasena II is related to which of the following ruling dynasties?
solution:
**Maitraka**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dhruvasena II**

 
 
• **Dhruvasena II **was a ruler of the Maitraka dynasty.
 
• The Maitraka dynasty ruled parts of western India, particularly Gujarat, during the 5th to 8th centuries CE.
 
• The dynasty was founded by **Senapati Bhatarka,** a general of the Gupta Empire who declared independence in the mid-5th century.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vakataka Dynasty**

 
 
• A significant Indian dynasty that ruled parts of central and southern India around the 3rd to 5th centuries CE.
 
• **Founded by Vindhyashakti.**
 
• The dynasty is known for its contributions to art and architecture, particularly the Ajanta Caves.
 
 
 
• **Pushyabhuti Dynasty**
 
 
• Also known as the **Vardhana dynasty,** it ruled parts of northern India in the 6th and 7th centuries CE.
 
• **Founded by Pushyabhuti.**
 
• The most notable ruler was **Harsha Vardhana**, who unified northern India.
 
 
 
• **Maukhari Dynasty**
 
 
• A ruling dynasty in northern India during the 6th and 7th centuries CE.
 
• **Founded by Harivarman.**
 
• The dynasty is known for its conflict with the later Gupta rulers and contributions to early medieval politics in India.
